question: How do I reset my account password?
answer: To reset your password, click on the 'Forgot Password' link on the sign-in page. Enter your registered email address, and we will send you a secure password reset link valid for 1 hour. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication (2FA)?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Click 'Enable 2FA' and scan the provided QR code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Authy. Enter the 6-digit confirmation code to activate.

question: Can I change my registered email address?
answer: Yes. Navigate to Account Settings > Profile > Email Address. Click 'Edit', enter your new email address, and confirm your current password. We will send a verification link to your new address to confirm the change.

question: How do I delete my account permanently?
answer: To permanently delete your account, visit Account Settings > Privacy & Data > Delete Account. Please note that account deletion is irreversible and removes all your saved data, history, and active subscriptions immediately.

question: Why is my account locked or suspended?
answer: Accounts are automatically locked after 5 consecutive unsuccessful login attempts or if suspicious activity is detected. Check your inbox for an account unlock email, or wait 30 minutes for the automatic cooldown.

question: How do I update my phone number for SMS verification?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Security > Phone Verification. Click 'Update Phone Number', enter the new number, and verify it with the one-time passcode (OTP) sent via SMS.

question: Can multiple team members share the same login?
answer: We do not recommend sharing individual login credentials. Instead, invite team members through the 'Team Management' dashboard under the Enterprise/Team plan, where you can assign custom role-based access permissions.

question: Where can I see recent login activity and active sessions?
answer: You can review active sessions under Settings > Security > Active Sessions. This section displays device types, IP locations, and login timestamps, along with an option to 'Log Out of All Other Devices'.

question: What should I do if I suspect unauthorized access to my account?
answer: Immediately change your password, revoke all active sessions in Settings > Security, and contact our security team at security@example.com with the incident details.

question: Does your platform support Single Sign-On (SSO)?
answer: Yes, Single Sign-On (SSO) via SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) including Google Workspace, Okta, and Azure AD is available on our Enterprise tier plans.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept major credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and ACH wire transfers for annual enterprise contracts.

question: How do I upgrade or downgrade my subscription plan?
answer: Go to Billing & Plans > Subscription. Click 'Change Plan', select your desired tier, and confirm. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated billing. Downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle.

question: How do I download my monthly invoices and receipts?
answer: You can download past VAT-compliant invoices by visiting Settings > Billing > Invoices. Click 'Download PDF' next to the corresponding billing period.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: You can cancel your subscription at any time by going to Billing > Manage Subscription > Cancel Subscription. You will retain access to your plan until the end of your current prepaid billing cycle.

question: Do you offer discounts for non-profits or students?
answer: Yes! We offer a 50% discount for registered non-profit organizations and accredited educational institutions or students. Submit proof of verification through our Education & Non-Profit application form.

question: What happens if my renewal payment fails?
answer: If a renewal payment fails, we retry charging your payment method 3 times over 7 days. You will receive email notifications. If uncollected after 7 days, the account will be paused until payment is updated.

question: Can I switch between monthly and annual billing?
answer: Yes, navigate to Billing > Manage Subscription and toggle to 'Annual Billing' to save up to 20% compared to monthly payments. The switch will be prorated against your remaining monthly credit.

question: How do I update my billing address and credit card details?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods. Click 'Update Card' or 'Edit Billing Address' to input your new payment details securely.

question: Is sales tax or VAT included in the price?
answer: Prices displayed are exclusive of local taxes. Applicable VAT, GST, or local sales taxes are automatically calculated and displayed at checkout based on your country and billing address.

question: Do you offer a free trial, and does it require a credit card?
answer: We offer a 14-day full-featured free trial for new users. No credit card is required to begin your trial period.

question: How can I track my physical shipment or order status?
answer: Once your order ships, an automated confirmation email with a tracking number and courier link (FedEx, UPS, or DHL) will be sent. You can also view live tracking under 'My Orders' in your account dashboard.

question: What are your standard shipping delivery times?
answer: Standard domestic shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping delivers within 1-2 business days. International deliveries usually take between 7-14 business days depending on customs clearance.

question: Can I modify or cancel an order after placing it?
answer: You can edit shipping addresses or cancel an order within 1 hour of placement from the 'My Orders' tab. After 1 hour, processing begins in our fulfillment warehouse and cancellations can no longer be processed.

question: Do you ship internationally to all countries?
answer: We ship to over 120 countries worldwide. International shipping fees and duties/taxes are calculated dynamically during checkout based on your destination country.

question: What happens if my package is marked delivered but I haven't received it?
answer: Please verify with neighbors or building reception first. If not found within 24 hours of the delivery notification, file a lost shipment claim with our support team at support@example.com for immediate replacement.

question: Are shipping fees refundable?
answer: Standard shipping fees are non-refundable once an item has been dispatched. If the return is due to a defective product or our fulfillment error, we will cover all shipping costs.

question: How do I split an order across multiple shipping addresses?
answer: Currently, each individual order can only ship to a single address. To deliver items to multiple locations, please place separate orders for each destination.

question: What should I do if I received damaged items?
answer: Take clear photos of the damaged items and the packaging exterior within 48 hours of receipt. Contact support@example.com with your order number to receive a free replacement or full refund.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for software subscriptions and unused physical products in their original packaging. Simply contact support within 30 days of purchase to initiate a return.

question: How long does it take to process a refund?
answer: Once approved, refunds are processed within 3-5 business days. Depending on your financial institution or credit card provider, it may take an additional 5-10 business days to appear on your bank statement.

question: How do I generate a prepaid return shipping label?
answer: Visit Returns Center in your account dashboard, enter your order number and zip code, select the items you wish to return, and print the generated prepaid return label.

question: Can digital downloadable products or API credits be refunded?
answer: Unused digital credits or license keys can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Once API credits have been consumed or license keys activated, they are non-refundable.

question: Are there any restocking fees on returned items?
answer: We do not charge restocking fees on items returned in their original, unopened condition. Opened or missing accessory returns may incur a 15% restocking fee.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different color or size?
answer: Yes, select 'Exchange' instead of 'Refund' in the Returns Portal. Choose your replacement item, and it will be dispatched as soon as the carrier scans your return package.

question: What if I received a refund for the wrong amount?
answer: Please review your invoice for deductions such as shipping charges or promotional discounts. If you still believe there is a discrepancy, forward your receipt to billing@example.com.

question: Can I receive my refund to a different bank card or account?
answer: Due to banking compliance and anti-fraud regulations, refunds can only be issued to the original payment method used during purchase. If your card was canceled, your bank will route the credit to your associated account.

question: Where can I find the API documentation and rate limits?
answer: Full REST API documentation is available at https://docs.example.com/api. Standard tiers allow 1,000 requests/minute, and Enterprise plans offer custom higher limits with guaranteed SLA.

question: How do I generate or revoke API keys?
answer: Log in to your developer dashboard and go to Settings > Developer Settings > API Keys. Click 'Generate New Secret Key'. Keep your key private, and click 'Revoke' immediately if a key is compromised.

question: What webhooks are supported for event notifications?
answer: We support webhooks for billing events, user creation, order status changes, and authentication logs. Configure your HTTPS webhook endpoint in Developer Settings > Webhooks.

question: What programming language SDKs do you provide?
answer: We maintain official SDKs for Python (`pip install example-sdk`), Node.js/TypeScript (`npm install @example/sdk`), Go, and Java. Community SDKs for Ruby and PHP are also available.

question: What browsers and devices are supported?
answer: Our web platform officially supports the latest versions of Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, Microsoft Edge, and modern mobile browsers on iOS and Android.

question: How do I check system uptime and service incidents?
answer: You can monitor live uptime, maintenance schedules, and incident reports 24/7 on our public status page at https://status.example.com.

question: Is my data encrypted at rest and in transit?
answer: Yes. All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.3, and data at rest is encrypted using industry-standard AES-256 encryption. We are SOC-2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified.

question: How do I report a security vulnerability or bug?
answer: We maintain a responsible disclosure bug bounty program. Please submit details of any potential vulnerability to security@example.com with reproducible steps.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach our customer support team 24/7 via live chat in the bottom right corner of the dashboard, or by emailing support@example.com. Enterprise customers have dedicated phone support.

question: What are your business customer support hours?
answer: Live chat and email support are available 24/7/365. Dedicated phone support for Enterprise clients is available Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST.

question: Can I export my data from the platform?
answer: Yes. Navigate to Settings > Account > Data Export. You can request a complete archive of your account data in JSON or CSV format. An email link will be delivered once the export bundle is compiled.

question: Is dark mode available in the application?
answer: Yes. Click your profile avatar in the upper right corner, and toggle between 'Light', 'Dark', or 'Match System Settings'.

question: Can I invite external collaborators or guest users?
answer: Yes, on Pro and Enterprise plans, you can invite unlimited read-only or commenting guests without consuming full paid user seats. Configure guest permissions in Team Settings > Guests.

question: Where can I request new features or submit product feedback?
answer: We love customer ideas! Submit and upvote feature requests on our public roadmap portal at https://roadmap.example.com or post them directly in our community forum.

question: How do I enable desktop or mobile push notifications?
answer: Go to Settings > Notifications > Channels. Toggle 'Browser Push' or install our mobile app from the iOS App Store / Google Play Store and permit notifications in your phone settings.

question: What compliance certifications do you hold (GDPR, HIPAA)?
answer: Our platform is fully GDPR compliant, SOC-2 Type II certified, and provides Business Associate Agreements (BAA) for HIPAA compliance on Enterprise healthcare tiers.
